title: BookingResponse
description: Norvia's answer to a booking sent to the Norvia Partner API (version 1). The result says which of the four answers it is; each comes with its own HTTP status, listed in the Partner API README.

messageId.description: Norvia's ID for this attempt (the correlation ID). Quote it when asking Norvia about the booking.

bookingRef.description: The Shipper's reference from the booking, when it had one.

norviaOrderNo.description: Norvia's order number for the booking. Quote it in later contact with Norvia.

accepted.description: HTTP 201. Norvia accepted the booking and gave it an order number.

alreadyBooked.description: HTTP 200. Norvia already has this booking (the same reference with the same content) and returns its original order number. Nothing new was booked.

rejected.description: HTTP 422. Norvia did not accept the booking, for every reason listed. Fix them all and send the booking again; the same reference may be used.

code.description: A stable code for the reason, such as GoodsLinesMissing. The codes are listed in the P1 process document.

notReceived.description: HTTP 502. Norvia could not take the booking in, because the TMS could not be reached or the integration layer failed, so nothing was booked. Send it again later; if Norvia did book it in the meantime, the answer is ALREADY_BOOKED.
